decomposition: y = z(logP) + z(-SA) + z(cycle), z over the 249,456-molecule GVAE property table; recomputed here from the verified RDKit molecule
threshold_rationale: the stored labels use the GVAE pipeline's own z constants, which differ slightly from the ones recomputed from the frozen property table; the residual therefore scales with |cycle| (median ~0.002 at cycle=0, ~0.11 at cycle=-1, 0.0619 at cycle=-2). 0.5 is far above that systematic class and far below the two genuine mismatches
outlier_interpretation: both outliers are low-error rows, so they do not drive any failure row; they are SMILES-sidecar identity mismatches (graph-isomorphic but different substitution) and are reported as data-side caveats, not as error causes
